description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for network diagnostic tools, including testing connectivity, checking IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, and performing traceroutes. It includes frontend HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP code for rendering the UI, validating input, and making AJAX requests to backend handlers.

methods.name: showTracerouteDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog with traceroute results, with adjustable width and close functionality.

methods.name: checkTraceError
methods.description: Analyzes traceroute results for error states and updates UI accordingly, showing error dialogs if needed.
